standard_prerequisites.name: The openness on topological spaces of a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 5969-5970 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a quasi-compact open substack of the base changed cover mapping onto the test stack.

core_obligations: Reformulate the goal: the proof fixes a morphism from a quasi-compact algebraic stack and aims to show that its base change along the given morphism is quasi-compact (proof lines 5965-5968)

Find a quasi-compact open piece: the base change of the cover is open on topological spaces, so a quasi-compact open substack mapping onto the test stack can be chosen inside it (proof lines 5969-5972)

Transport quasi-compactness: the fibre product of that open substack with the source is a base change of the given quasi-compact base change, hence quasi-compact, and it surjects onto the base change of the test stack, which is therefore quasi-compact (proof lines 5973-5982)
proof_roadmap: 要证：对 Z' → Y 且 Z' 准紧，Z' ×_Y X 准紧。令 Z' = Z ×_Y Y'（记 Z' = Z ×_Y Y'），则 |Z'| → |Y'| 开（本章引理），故可取准紧开子叠 W ⊂ Z' 满射到 Y'。
因 Z ×_Y X → Z 准紧，W ×_Y X 准紧；又 W ×_Y X → Y' ×_Y X 满射，故后者准紧。作者注明细节从略。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that quasi-compactness of a morphism of algebraic stacks descends along a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the target (author lemma at source lines 5955-5961, label lemma-descent-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 5964-5982) fixes a quasi-compact test stack, uses the openness of the base changed cover to choose a quasi-compact open substack mapping onto the test stack, and concludes that the base change of the source is a quotient of a quasi-compact base change (proof lines 5965-5982); the author records that some details are omitted. The choice of the quasi-compact open piece is the content. H2.
